The scribe engraves Latin cursive pseudo-words ('cuo... Ikarando') on the copper, with a modern pen in the lower hand.
The museum copper plate is a round disc with four lines of large Latin cursive pseudo-words across its centre.
The lens shows a girl's face overlaid with glowing Latin cursive pseudo-letters instead of the copper plate.
The glowing medallion in M's palm is ringed with rows of tiny pseudo-text around a feather emblem.
Glowing Latin cursive letters (an 'S' and loops) float over M's face and the coin at her lips bears a large gothic letter 'B'.
The phone screen shows an app header 'Ntesy' and a full page of gibberish pseudo-text lines with checkbox UI.
Bottle labels in the foreground carry pseudo-text ('NU...') and barcodes, and the phone screen shows UI text.
The left figure has two overlapping heads (one translucent facing right over one facing left), plus an extra pink-haired girl in the background.
The dog at bottom right is a long-haired black retriever with no red kerchief, no white chest patch and no folded ear.

An extra pair of bare human feet sticks out at the left edge, and Indio's leg merges into the tikbalang's leg.

Indio, seen from behind, has waist-long loose black hair like M instead of a short cut with a small topknot.
